final: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.gender, COUNT(o.order_id) AS number_of_orders FROM Customers AS c LEFT JOIN Orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.gender IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.gender) <> '' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.gender), shares AS (SELECT customer_id, gender, number_of_orders, 1.0 * number_of_orders / NULLIF(SUM(number_of_orders) OVER (PARTITION BY gender), 0) AS share FROM order_counts), compared AS (SELECT customer_id, gender, number_of_orders, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS gap_above_average FROM shares) SELECT customer_id, gender, number_of_orders, share, gap_above_average FROM compared WHERE gap_above_average > 0 ORDER BY gap_above_average DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
